Subject: Your cheque bounce matter

Dear Ms. Desai,

Thank you for meeting us on 19 August 2022 about your dispute with Vindhya Textiles Pvt Ltd. As we understand it, the cheque came back with the remark account closed.

Our advice is to treat the closure of the account as evidence of dishonest intent and oppose any compounding below the full cheque amount. Please collect the cheque, the return memo showing the account was closed and the loan agreement and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of INR 42,50,000/-.

Regards,
Adv. Zubin Contractor
